name: ibitsa
description: Work with AI coding agents as a pixel-art RPG.

ibitsa.hero.budgetUsd.markdownDescription: A hero's gold pouch in US dollars. When it's spent, the hero stops and asks before spending more. Leave empty for no cap.

ibitsa.parties.maxParallel.markdownDescription: How many parties (heroes on their own islands) work at the same time. The others wait for a free slot and start by themselves.

ibitsa.campaign.budgetUsd.markdownDescription: The most a whole campaign may spend, in US dollars: every hero plus the elder and the council. When it's reached, every hero stops and asks. Leave empty for no cap.

ibitsa.checks.markdownDescription: Commands run as checks when a hero submits a task, one at a time, stopping at the first failure (e.g. `pnpm test`). Leave empty to use the worktree's `package.json` scripts named `test`, `lint`, `typecheck` or `check`; an empty list `[]` runs no checks.

ibitsa.review.loopLimit.markdownDescription: Review rounds before a task that keeps getting blocking findings comes to you.

ibitsa.pullRequests.pollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often, in seconds, open pull requests are checked on GitHub for their badges, while a campaign runs.

ibitsa.worktree.setup.markdownDescription: A command run in each new worktree before the hero starts, e.g. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Empty runs nothing.

ibitsa.hero.settingSources.markdownDescription: Which Claude Code settings hero sessions load. `project`: the repo's `CLAUDE.md`, skills and rules. Adding `user` also loads your personal `~/.claude` skills and `CLAUDE.md` **and your personal permission rules and hooks**, which can let a hero do more without asking.

ibitsa.elder.model.markdownDescription: The model the elder researches a new quest with, before the council or a quick quest.

ibitsa.elder.budgetUsd.markdownDescription: The most the elder's research may cost, in US dollars. It stops when the cap is reached.

enumDescriptions: Ask each time the council convenes.
One session voices every councillor: cheaper and quicker.
Each councillor studies alone after the elder's briefing: sharper roles, costs more.
ibitsa.council.mode.markdownDescription: How the council sits when you convene it.

ibitsa.council.consultBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: The most one question to the council mid-campaign (`@council`, `@<councillor>` or the hut) may spend, in dollars.

ibitsa.council.disabled.markdownDescription: Councillors the council never seats, by id (a councillor skill's name, e.g. `designer`). Ibitsa's built-ins are `architect`, `tester`, `accessibility`, `security` and `designer`.

ibitsa.councillors.markdownDescription: Overrides for councillors, by id: `title`, `model`, `tools` (read-only ones only) and `portrait`. The skill file stays as it is. Edit them in the Guild Hall's Roster.

ibitsa.claudeCodePath.markdownDescription: Path to a `claude` executable to use instead of the one bundled with the extension. Empty uses the bundled one.

ibitsa.pack.markdownDescription: The asset pack the game draws with: `default`, or `user:<folder>` (in `~/.ibitsa/packs/`) or `project:<folder>` (in `.ibitsa/packs/`). Choose it in the Guild Hall's Packs tab.
